title: NCLT Chennai Sanctions Merger of Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Into Dr. Agarwal's Health Care
case_name: In re: Scheme of Amalgamation of Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited with Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited
card_summary: After the Chennai Bench allowed the first motion in May 2026 and unsecured creditors cleared the scheme in July 2026, the Tribunal sanctioned the second motion merging Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited into Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited. The scheme runs under Sections 230-232 of the Companies Act, 2013, with 23 shares of the health care company issued for every two shares of the eye hospital company.
card_tip: Even a sanctioned scheme of amalgamation is not automatically effective; track the scheme's own conditions precedent and the registrar filing before treating the merger as complete.
verification_notes: The Chennai Bench, the bench composition (Sanjiv Jain and Venkataraman Subramaniam), the 23:2 share exchange ratio, the May 2026 first motion and July 2026 creditor approval timeline, and the sanction of the second motion are consistent across LiveLaw's and Multibagg's reports. The certified order itself was not independently retrieved, and reports differ slightly on whether the sanction hearing fell on 30 September or was only uploaded by 5 October 2026.
